appendix.annual_reset_semantics: annual-reset re-settlement of continuous-path decisions: the same stakes, compounded from the declared opening balance at the start of each test year. Not an annual-reset sizing simulation -- stakes are not re-solved from reset capital, and doing so would change which bets are placed rather than only how they compound.
appendix.authoring_note: definition, raw_source, units, default_behavior, higher_value_meaning and known_caveats are intentionally blank. They are claims about the domain, not properties derivable from the model, and inventing them would produce documentation that reads as authoritative and is not.

training_window.detail: a separate fit per evaluation year, each on 2010 through the year before it -- 11 fits in all
training_window.sentence: The 2016 evaluation model was trained on the initial 2010-2015 set. Each later evaluation adds the preceding complete season, so the training window expands by one year; the 2026 model uses 2010-2025. Every evaluation year is fitted separately -- 11 fits in all -- and no evaluation year's outcomes appear in its own fit.
training_window.summary: initial 2010-2015, expanding by one season per evaluation year

identity.label: Softmax
identity.market_reference: the market's own implied probabilities on the same races, normalised within each race

attribution_basis.baseline: the booster's intercept, with no market anchor
attribution_basis.sentence: Each feature's effect below is its contribution to this model's whole fitted utility, not to a correction of the market. The baseline is the booster's own intercept, and the market's implied probability is one of the features being attributed rather than the point of comparison -- so these magnitudes are larger than the market-anchored reports' and are not comparable with them term by term.

delta_semantics.definition: model race log loss minus market race log loss, paired by race

assumptions: Model probabilities are assumed exactly correct.
Historical Win Odds are held fixed and used as the gross return proxy.
Race opportunities and chronology are as observed.
Winners are drawn independently per race from the stored probabilities.
The model is not refitted inside a replicate.
Model error, drift, market response and regime change are excluded.
model_assumed.label: Rebate-aware Kelly, large-bank limit
model_assumed.large_bank_caveat: The rebate threshold is treated as always met. This is a scale-free asymptotic policy, not the exact finite HK$1B bankroll scenario.
model_assumed.population_rule: every race in the standardized evaluation window that the settlement can settle, not the subset this model staked. An unstaked race has multiplier exactly 1 under both policies, so including it changes no terminal figure; excluding it made the race sequence -- and with it the checkpoints and the shared random draws -- a property of the model, which is what stopped two reports' fan charts being comparable.
model_assumed.rounding_treatment: omitted; minimum-bet rounding vanishes in the scale-free limit
